svg.title: Downunder Voices Cartoon of the Day — Australia's loneliest echidna finds a plus-one
svg.desc: Original pen-and-ink editorial cartoon. On a windswept Bass Strait island with granite boulders, she-oaks, tussock grass and the sea behind, a wildlife trail camera on a weathered post watches two echidnas meet on a sandy track. One asks, "So... come here often?" The other, shyly holding a bunch of wildflowers, replies, "Only since the cats moved out." A small heart floats between them. A fictional park ranger in a wide-brimmed hat peeks over a boulder, grinning, and updates the echidna count in a notebook from one to two.
svg.text: DOWNUNDER VOICES — CARTOON OF THE DAY
AUSTRALIA'S LONELIEST ECHIDNA HAS FOUND A PLUS-ONE.
Source: ABC Northern Tasmania, 5 Nov 2026 — a Clarke Island ranger spotted an echidna; camera images suggest there are more.
